theme_strategy.architecture: CSS Variables applied via [data-theme="<theme_name>"] attribute on the <html> or :root element.
theme_strategy.global_transition: All thematic properties (background-color, color, border-color, box-shadow) MUST include a transition of 300ms ease-in-out. Use: 'transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;' on global elements.
theme_strategy.core_restrictions: DO NOT change textual content, pricing table structure, LORD logo, Hotmart integration, language translation button logic/visibility, or section order. No parallax. No heavy/distracting animations.

hero.version_b_material: Centered or 50/50 layout. Use pill-shaped primary buttons. Add a subtle shadow to the CTA. Software badge should be fully rounded.
hero.version_c_futuristic: Massive typography (60-100px). Minimalist pill/rectangular CTA. Implement a SINGLE 1px animated glowing line (Scanner effect) across the hero. Fade-in on scroll.
hero.version_d_light: High contrast text. Navy CTA (#0A0F1E) with lime (#CCFF00) text. Clean, generous spacing. Subtle inner shadow on the badge.

multi_sport_board.version_b_material: Elevated cards (Shadow 1) with surface color #1E1E1E. Rounded 24px.
multi_sport_board.version_c_futuristic: Bento grid approach. Flat dark cards #080D1A with 1px low opacity border. No shadow.
multi_sport_board.version_d_light: White cards on #F5F7FA background. Soft shadow, #E2E8F0 border.

features.version_b_material: Material icons, rounded feature containers, hover elevation lift.
features.version_c_futuristic: Extremely generous whitespace. Grid layout. 1px borders dividing features (Linear style shell).
features.version_d_light: Notion-like simplicity. Left-aligned, crisp typography. Soft grey containers.

pricing_table.rules: DO NOT change text, pricing tiers, or layout structure.
pricing_table.version_b_material: Elevated central/popular card. Rounded top headers.
pricing_table.version_c_futuristic: Flat cards. Popular card distinguished by a 1px glowing neon border.
pricing_table.version_d_light: White cards. Navy CTA for the popular tier.

blog.version_b_material: Card-based layout (image on top, text below). Rounded 24px, subtle shadows.
blog.version_c_futuristic: 1px grid list. Hovering over a blog post faintly glows the border. Sharp corners.
blog.version_d_light: Clean, light cards with soft shadows. Serif/Sans mix for editorial feel if possible, else stick to Inter.

api_docs.version_b_material: Floating Action Button (FAB) for navigation, Material sidebar.
api_docs.version_c_futuristic: Stripe-inspired. Dark canvas, 2-column layout. Berkeley/JetBrains Mono for code. Sharp neon syntax highlighting.
api_docs.version_d_light: Linear light docs style. High contrast syntax highlighting on #F5F7FA code blocks.

support.version_b_material: Material Expansion Panels for FAQs. Filled text fields for form.
support.version_c_futuristic: Flat accordions with 1px border bottoms. Minimalist input lines (border bottom only).
support.version_d_light: Clean boxed accordions. Standard outlined inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not rewrite textual content, pricing data, or core structural components. Only wrap/style them using the defined CSS variables.
2. Implement a theme switcher widget (e.g., floating or in the footer) that toggles the data-theme attribute on <html> between 'classic', 'material', 'futuristic', and 'light'.
3. Apply 'transition: all 0.3s ease' globally to backgrounds, text colors, and borders to ensure the 300ms smooth theme switch.
4. For Version C (futuristic), implement a single 1px glowing animated line in the hero section using CSS animations or Framer Motion.
5. Build the Resources pages (Blog, API Docs, Support) reusing the token system so they automatically adapt to the 4 themes.
6. Ensure the language selector (12 idiomas) remains visible, functioning, and properly themed across all 4 versions.
7. MUST add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
